This is a long text to check continuous synthesis. The device reads the whole message without an artificial pause, following the punctuation: commas, full stops and question marks. Can you follow it? The next sentence has numbers, such as 2026 and 3.14, and a time, 8:15. Then come borrowed words with accents, such as café and naïve. The goal is to measure the synthesis time, the time to the first sample and the identity of the audio between the computer and the board, item by item, without exception. Finally, the message ends here, with a full stop.
